meta.name: x-mankier
meta.description:
Search and browse man pages from ManKier.com.
Command line interface for ManKier man page repository.

**Dependency**: This is an x-cmd module. Install x-cmd first (see x-cmd skill for installation options).
see x-cmd skill for installation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在终端中搜索和浏览 man 手册页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在终端查命令帮助文档
copy.tagline_en: Search and browse man pages in the terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often look up command help in the terminal

howto.what: 安装后，你可以让Claude解释Shell命令的选项、搜索和浏览ManKier.com上的手册页，并获取特定章节或完整手册内容。
howto.when: 当你需要理解复杂命令的选项、查找命令手册或获取特定手册章节时，可以要求Claude使用此技能。

say.text: 解释一下 tar -czvf 这个命令的选项。
搜索 ls 命令的手册页。
获取 tar 手册的NAME章节。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can explain shell command options, search and browse man pages from ManKier.com, and retrieve specific sections or full manual content.
howto.when_en: When you need to understand complex command options, find command manuals, or get specific manual sections, you can ask Claude to use this skill.

say_en.text: Explain the options of the command tar -czvf.
say_en.note: Claude will call x mankier explain to explain the command.

say_en.text: Search for the man page of ls.
say_en.note: Claude will call x mankier query to search for relevant pages.

say_en.text: Get the NAME section of the tar manual.
say_en.note: Claude will call x mankier section to retrieve the specified section.
